resources.string: Using the default profile, no extra rules
Install .zip from storage, or browse repo online
Root, and it looks good too
FoxSu is a KernelSU-based root manager: kernel-level privileges, modules and image flashing, plus five interface styles and deep customization — all open source.
Aurora Glass, Pages, Editorial, Daylight and Nocturne — each with its own tokens, spacing and motion. Switching applies instantly, no restart.
Tap a card to apply it instantly.
Daylight by default, night on demand
Pure white, a single blue accent
From the dock to the icon
Wallpaper, typography, card surface, corner radius and dock shapes — every layer is yours, shared by all five skins.
One image behind every page, croppable
Serif, mono, WenKai or your own file
10 button shapes, side drawer, rainbow icons
Four fox styles, swapped on the home screen
From flashing a kernel to granting root per app, every kernel-side switch lives on one layer of the UI.
Grant or revoke root per process
Install, update, remove, WebUI, online repo search
Read the live state of your device
Local LKM / online OTA / direct flash, boot backed up first
Allowlist plus App Profile (uid / caps / SELinux)
SELinux state, hidden changes, soft reboot, late-load LKM
Every grant and denial recorded, clearable per app
Five skins, ten dock shapes, image install, module repo, App Profile — the code is public. Issues and PRs welcome.
Kernel-level root, with an interface worth looking at.
GPL-3.0 · based on KernelSU by tiann
Pill, circle, squircle, outline, double, cut, keycap, card, glass, glow. Pick one and all four buttons at the bottom change together.
Not a mock-up: picking a shape writes the real setting — you will see it after this tour.
This is more than a skin. Flash a kernel, mount modules, grant root per app — all on the same layer.
Built-in metamodule · shipped with the APK
These numbers are read from this device when the page opens.
Swipe for more\nThree large cards · apply instantly
TAP A CARD TO APPLY · TAP OUTSIDE TO CLOSE
Ships in a bright Daylight look (F4F5FA) with violet and mint accents; switch to the OLED night theme whenever you like. Applies instantly — no restart.
The daylight twin of Nocturne: paper-white panels with violet and mint, easier to read outdoors.
Paper texture, hairline rules and signal orange. Built for long reading sessions, tighter type.
Pure white, a single blue accent, the least decoration. Lowest information density.
HyperOS-flavoured lavender panels: white cards, violet accents, large grouped corners.
